findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous use of pickle in aiohttp
 * @description Detects uses of pickle load/loads which may deserialize untrusted data
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/aiohttp-pickle-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
select call, "Potential unsafe deserialization using pickle. Ensure the data is trusted."
findings.hypothesis: aiohttp may use pickle for (de)serialization, which is unsafe on untrusted data

message.text: Potential unsafe deserialization using pickle. Ensure the data is trusted.
